label: preparing
what: A surprise community supper in the great hall on day 1 at 18:00, concealed from the mayor: organizing 200 fresh loaves on four tables, grain and funding, eight installed lanterns, and an innkeeper escort. The mayor approved a lighting/readiness check at that time, but the record does not show he was told about the supper. No additional knowing helper is established; the secretary confirmed the appointment but is not shown knowing the surprise.
